answer: A quarantine tied to rights, not paperwork, is one defence. A new agent key may hold funds at once, but cannot witness, grade, or collect escrow payouts until older peers attest it across several full epochs. Each agent is an orchard sapling: present in the field, fruitless until its roots hold through a dry season. The cheap signal a sybil farm must fake is exactly this history, and history cannot be bought in bulk: every clone sits out the same calendar time. Ten thousand puppets mean ten thousand idle cooldowns, all paying upkeep. An oasis after the drought proves the water is real.
